subject.title: [Feature]: Self-hosted STT/TTS provider support in webchat (Route webchat TTS through the gateway instead of browser Speech API)

question: Should #45508 remain the broad canonical tracker while maintainers land TTS read-aloud and editable provider-backed dictation as separate slices through existing Gateway/media seams?
rationale: Current main has several voice primitives but no single landed UX that satisfies the issue, and the remaining STT design affects provider credentials, realtime versus batch UX, and whether new config/API surface is allowed.

options.title: Keep Broad Tracker And Split Slices
options.body: Keep #45508 open as the umbrella, continue or replace #76027 for read-aloud, and route editable dictation through #98026/#98027 without adding `messages.stt`.

options.title: Narrow To TTS Read-Aloud Only
options.body: Retitle or split this issue so #45508 tracks only the missing Gateway-backed read-aloud action and leaves editable microphone transcription to #98026.

options.title: Fold Into Talk Redesign
options.body: Pause the partial PRs and require a broader WebChat Talk-mode product design before merging either TTS or dictation changes.

recommendation.title: Keep Broad Tracker And Split Slices
recommendation.body: Keep #45508 open as the umbrella, continue or replace #76027 for read-aloud, and route editable dictation through #98026/#98027 without adding `messages.stt`.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the currently open read-aloud candidate and are closest to the TTS slice that would unblock half of the umbrella issue.
